acceptance: Locale comes only from what the page declares and is canonicalised like the Rust identity layer; viewport is bucketed; flags come from configured probes; unknown inputs stay unknown in the cache overlay and make it non-shareable.

positive.fixture: 6 browser and 5 unit tests: lang, content-language, resize and flag changes publish and move the overlay

negative.fixture: the browser language never fills a missing locale; unreadable flags stay unknown; awkward flag values cannot alias

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Environment probes run only when a related mutation or resize is seen.
known_limitations: Flags are visible only through configured probes
